target.title: fix(app): honor task cancellation in app running-state wait loop
target.body:
## Summary

`AppTool.waitForRunningState` polled with `try? await Task.sleep` and never checked `Task.isCancelled`. After the parent task was cancelled, the wait could still burn the full timeout (same bug class as daemon poll loops fixed in #203).

This PR adds a `guard !Task.isCancelled` after each sleep and a standalone proof script.

## Failure scenario

1. App launch/quit waits for running state with a multi-second timeout.
2. Caller cancels the task (user abort, tool timeout wrapper, etc.).
3. Unfixed: loop continues until the full timeout budget is consumed.
4. Fixed: loop returns on the first post-cancel iteration.

## Verification

- `swiftc -parse-as-library -o /tmp/prove-app scripts/prove-app-wait-poll-cancellation.swift && /tmp/prove-app` → `PROOF_OK` (fixed iters << unfixed iters after cancel)
- `swift build --target PeekabooAgentRuntime` → complete

## Related

- #203 daemon poll cancellation (same `try?` + missing `Task.isCancelled` pattern)

## Scope

`waitForRunningState` only.
